context: The skill should recognize absence-as-error and use orElseThrow directly instead of banning orElseThrow.

checklist.name: Uses orElseThrow
checklist.description: Uses Optional.ofNullable(...).orElseThrow(...) or equivalent direct absence-as-error handling.

checklist.name: Preserves exception
checklist.description: Preserves IllegalArgumentException and the message prefix "Missing config: ".

checklist.name: Does not overgeneralize
checklist.description: Does not claim orElseThrow is always bad or replace it with null/fake collection control flow.
